Dinosaur Dooley, The.name: The Dinosaur Dooley
Dinosaur Dooley, The.summary: The Dinosaur Dooley is a Shoot-'Em-Up game, developed by Daou and published by Innovation Tech, which was released in Korea in 1991.

Gotris.name: Gotris
Gotris.summary: Gotris is the impossible mix of the ancient game of GO and the mighty Tetris. Surround pieces from one colour with the ones of the other colour in order to clear them and earn points!
